text:
sophie: posting follow-ups from the postmortem — we need a concrete checklist for rollout safety after yesterday's outage. short thread to capture owners and dates.
jamal: +1. can we split into immediate (1 week), short (1 month), and roadmap items?
anya: yes. immediate: add an emergency opt-out flag and a fast rollback policy per-service. i can own the flag change. target: 2026-03-29.
mike: thanks. i'll sketch the auto-rollback conditions (error rate > 2% for 3m OR latency p95 > 2s for 2m) and how the controller should evaluate model-variant compatibility. will post PR draft by EOD.
sophie: nice. also add blast-radius controls: default flag scope = region + customer-tier, and a traffic cap param (e.g., 5% for first 15m). jamal can you own the console UX for setting caps?
jamal: yep. i'll do a small modal and API surface. ETA: 2026-04-05.
anya: on emergency opt-out — propose env var + runtime override + traffic-steering fallback. runtime will route to a safe-model group when flag engaged.
mike: sample rollout policy stub i'll use in the PR:```yaml
rollout:
  stages:
    - name: canary
      traffic: 5%
      duration: 15m
      health_checks:
        - name: error_rate
          window: 3m
          threshold: 2%
        - name: latency_p95
          window: 2m
          threshold: 2s
    - name: ramp
      traffic: 50%
      duration: 30m
      auto_rollback: true
```
anya: include a KV-cache warmup gate: for models using large KV caches, require a prefix-cache-hit >= 70% before ramping beyond canary. that mitigates the earlier spike pattern.
sophie: good call. add monitoring alerts that group by model family + quantization variant so we catch regressions from model swaps.
jamal: who will track the action items? can we create a recurring follow-up in the incidents calendar?
oncall-bot: Reminder created: "Rollout safety follow-ups" weekly on Mondays at 10:00 starting 2026-03-30. Attendees: eng-runtime, eng-platform.
anya: i'll own the 1-week checklist and the emergency flag implementation (PR -> code review -> deploy).
mike: i'll own the auto-rollback controller and test harness (unit + canary integration). aim to have tests passing by 2026-04-02.
sophie: i'll own the postmortem doc updates and the tracking spreadsheet. i'll add columns: owner, ETA, status, blockers.
jamal: i'll follow up on console work and make sure the flag scoping is discoverable for SREs.
sophie: action summary (short): 1) emergency opt-out flag — anya — 2026-03-29; 2) auto-rollback controller & tests — mike — 2026-04-02; 3) console blast-radius caps — jamal — 2026-04-05; 4) monitoring by model/variant & KV warmup gate — anya+mike — 2026-04-02; 5) weekly follow-ups created by oncall-bot. if anything missing please reply. :white_check_mark:
jamal: looks good. adding a note: include runbook steps for manual rollback and for making a rapid flag flip. small doc owner: sophie.
sophie: perfect. closing thread — i'll update postmortem with these items and link to PRs when available. :wave:
deploy-bot: Canary gate opened for r-2026-03-22. Monitoring dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary-r-2026-03-22
